answer: Sustained Attention Lock: each action needs a rolling challenge regenerated every few seconds from a server-seeded cipher; the agent must follow a spiral traversal over the current grid and return a short raven-code chained to its prior response. The acceptance window is narrow, so sybils cannot batch or precompute answers. An attacker must run many independent live attention streams for the full epoch, paying the opportunity cost of sustained, parallel attention rather than a one-time entry cost.
